title: Balanced
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create an exceptionally crisp, high-fidelity desktop application UI design board for BYT (Book Your Time), a local timesheet reminder for Windows and macOS. This is an interface mockup, not a marketing page. Landscape board approximately 2400 x 1800, plain light neutral background, four straight-on app windows in a precise two-by-two grid, each representing the same compact roughly 800x600 desktop window. Equal scale, fully visible edges, no overlapping. Small external board labels identify the four views: Reminder, Setup, Status, Settings. A discreet external footer says "Illustrative dates and URL". Use large readable text and excellent professional spacing; every window must feel complete and implementable. No photographs, illustration, device renders, charts, analytics, sidebar navigation, unnecessary badges, or decorative panels.
Shared identity: warm-white #f7f8f5 background, muted forest green #42634a primary action, text #202520, restrained gray-green separators. Native-feeling system sans typography, regular and semibold, no oversized marketing typography. One very small BYT wordmark in each header, a simple outlined settings gear at top right of main views, plain Back control in Settings. Neutral desktop window titlebar, subtle corners and depth only at window boundaries. Only necessary task controls. Strong visual accessibility and comfortably sized click targets.

Four views and content:
REMINDER: heading "Time to submit your hours". Body "Two reminder dates are still unconfirmed." A simple date list "16 Oct 2026" with subdued "Earlier reminder" and "23 Oct 2026" with subdued "Today". No selection checkboxes, these are outstanding reminder dates and both clear together. Primary green "Open timesheet" button. Separate disabled neutral button "I've submitted my hours". Small clear explanation "Available 5 seconds after opening the timesheet." A lower-priority snooze control "Snooze for 15 min" with dropdown chevron; alternatives would be 30 min and 1 hour. A small line "Confirming submission clears both dates." No claims of automatic completion, no overdue warning.
SETUP: heading "Set up your reminders". Simple labeled text field "Timesheet URL" showing "https://timesheets.example.com". Labeled reminder schedule with a Weekly / Monthly segmented selector, Weekly selected. Weekday choice row M T W T F S S, Friday selected. Time field "17:00". One primary button "Start reminders". No login or signup.
STATUS: heading "You're all set". Plain prominent sentence "Next reminder: Fri, 30 Oct at 17:00". Supporting line "Every Friday at 17:00". A modest secondary "Open timesheet" button. A quiet footer "BYT keeps running when you close this window." No fake history, streaks, statistics or achievement illustration.
SETTINGS: heading "Settings". Timesheet URL text field and the same Weekly / Monthly schedule controls and Friday 17:00. A simple setting row labeled "Repeat reminder every" with value "5 minutes", a dropdown. A toggle row "Start at login" switched on. Primary "Save changes", secondary "Cancel". Content fits the compact app with intelligent spacing and no cramped text.
The layouts vary only as described by the variant direction below. Preserve exactly this product logic.

VARIANT A — BALANCED. All four windows use a calm centered single reading column of moderate width, generous but economical vertical spacing, conventional label-above-field forms. Reminder heading and two simple full-width date rows above vertically stacked primary and disabled completion buttons. Snooze sits under a thin separator at the bottom. Status left aligned in the same centered column, with next reminder as a clean two-line text group. This is the balanced professional default. External board heading 'A — Balanced'. No nested cards or large icons.
